subject: Biology
title: Human Reproduction
summary: Insaan sexually reproduce karte hain aur viviparous hain. Events: gametogenesis, insemination, fertilisation, cleavage, blastocyst ka banna, implantation, gestation aur parturition.

Male system mein testis (seminiferous tubules sperm banate hain; Leydig cells androgens), ducts, accessory glands aur penis. Female system mein ovary, oviducts, uterus, cervix, vagina aur mammary glands.

Spermatogenesis puberty par shuru hota hai aur har primary spermatocyte se chaar sperm deta hai; oogenesis janm se pehle shuru hota hai aur har primary oocyte se ek ovum. Menstrual cycle (~28 din) FSH, LH, oestrogen aur progesterone control karte hain.

Fertilisation oviduct ke ampullary region mein hota hai; blastocyst endometrium mein implantation karta hai; pregnancy mein placenta foetus ko sahara deta aur hormones banata hai. Parturition foetal ejection reflex aur oxytocin se; uske baad lactation.

formulas.name: Testis structure
formulas.formula: each testis ~250 testicular lobules, each with 1–3 seminiferous tubules;  lined by spermatogonia and Sertoli cells (nourish sperm);  Leydig (interstitial) cells outside tubules secrete androgens

formulas.name: Male duct path
formulas.formula: seminiferous tubules → rete testis → vasa efferentia → epididymis → vas deferens → ejaculatory duct → urethra

formulas.name: Male accessory glands
formulas.formula: paired seminal vesicles + prostate + paired bulbourethral glands → seminal plasma (fructose, Ca²⁺, enzymes); bulbourethral secretion lubricates the penis

formulas.name: Spermatogenesis
formulas.formula: spermatogonium (2n, 46) → primary spermatocyte (2n) → meiosis I → 2 secondary spermatocytes (n, 23) → meiosis II → 4 spermatids (n) → spermiogenesis → sperm;  release = spermiation

formulas.name: Hormonal control (male)
formulas.formula: GnRH → LH acts on Leydig cells (androgens);  FSH acts on Sertoli cells (factors helping spermiogenesis)

formulas.name: Sperm structure
formulas.formula: head (haploid nucleus + acrosome with enzymes for fertilisation) + neck + middle piece (mitochondria — energy) + tail;  ~200–300 million sperm per ejaculate; ≥ 60% normal shape and ≥ 40% vigorous motility needed for normal fertility

formulas.name: Oogenesis
formulas.formula: oogonia form in foetal life → primary oocyte (arrested in prophase I) in primary follicle → at puberty → secondary oocyte (n) + first polar body (Graafian follicle) → ovulation → meiosis II completes only after sperm entry → ovum + second polar body
formulas.mistake: Janm ke baad naye oogonia nahi bante; kai follicles khatam ho jaate hain, isliye puberty par har ovary mein sirf lagbhag 60,000–80,000 primary follicles bachte hain — dhyan rakho.

formulas.name: Menstrual cycle phases
formulas.formula: menstrual (days 1–5: endometrium breaks down);  follicular/proliferative (FSH, LH ↑; follicle grows, oestrogen rebuilds endometrium);  ovulation (~day 14: LH surge);  luteal/secretory (corpus luteum makes progesterone)

formulas.name: LH surge
formulas.formula: peak LH (and FSH) in mid-cycle → rupture of Graafian follicle → ovulation

formulas.name: Fertilisation
formulas.formula: in the ampullary region of the fallopian tube;  sperm contact zona pellucida → blocks entry of other sperm;  completes meiosis II of the secondary oocyte

formulas.name: Sex determination
formulas.formula: ovum always X;  sperm X or Y (50:50);  XX → female, XY → male
formulas.mistake: Baby ka sex pita ka sperm tay karta hai, maa nahi — galat mat likhna.

formulas.name: Early development
formulas.formula: zygote → cleavage → morula (8–16 cells) → blastocyst (trophoblast outside, inner cell mass inside) → implantation in endometrium

formulas.name: Pregnancy hormones
formulas.formula: placenta: hCG, hPL, oestrogens, progestogens;  ovary in late pregnancy: relaxin

formulas.name: Parturition and lactation
formulas.formula: foetal ejection reflex → oxytocin from posterior pituitary → strong uterine contractions;  colostrum (first milk) has IgA antibodies

examples.title: Gametes ki sankhya
examples.problem: Ek primary spermatocyte aur ek primary oocyte se kitne sperm aur ova bante hain?
examples.solution: Ek primary spermatocyte se 4 sperm; ek primary oocyte se 1 ovum (aur polar bodies).

examples.title: Spermatid mein chromosomes
examples.problem: Human spermatogonium mein 46 chromosomes hain. Spermatid mein kitne?

examples.title: Corpus luteum
examples.problem: Fertilisation na ho to corpus luteum ka kya hota hai?
examples.solution: Ye khatam (degenerate) ho jaata hai, progesterone girta hai, endometrium tootta hai aur menstruation shuru hota hai.

examples.title: Pregnancy test
examples.problem: Pregnancy test kit mein kaunsa hormone detect hota hai?
examples.solution: Human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG), placenta (trophoblast) banata hai — sirf pregnancy mein hota hai.

examples.title: Organs banne ki timeline
examples.problem: Foetus ki heartbeat kab shuru hoti hai aur limbs kab bante hain?
examples.solution: Pregnancy ke ek mahine baad heart banta hai; doosre mahine ke end tak limbs aur digits; 12 hafte (first trimester) ke end tak zyadatar bade organs ban chuke hote hain.

examples.title: Identical twins
examples.solution: Ek hi zygote (ya shuruaati embryo) do mein bat jaata hai, isliye dono ka genetic makeup same. Fraternal twins do alag eggs ke do sperm se fertilise hone se bante hain.

topics.title: Female reproductive system
topics.explain: Ovaries (2–4 cm lambi) stroma ke saath; oviducts mein infundibulum (fimbriae ovum pakadti hain), ampulla aur isthmus; uterus mein perimetrium, myometrium (smooth muscle; birth par tez contractions) aur endometrium (glandular; cyclic badlaav); cervix aur vagina. External genitalia: mons pubis, labia majora aur minora, hymen, clitoris.

topics.title: Mammary glands
topics.explain: Jodi mein, glandular tissue aur fat ke saath. Har breast mein 15–20 mammary lobes jinke alveoli doodh banate hain; doodh tubules, ducts, ampulla aur lactiferous duct se nipple tak jaata hai.

topics.title: Placenta
topics.explain: Chorionic villi (trophoblast se) aur uterine tissue se banta hai; embryo ko O₂ aur nutrients deta hai aur CO₂ aur waste hataata hai. Umbilical cord se embryo se juda aur endocrine tissue ki tarah kaam karta hai.

topics.title: Germ layers
topics.explain: Inner cell mass se ectoderm, mesoderm aur endoderm bante hain, jinse saare tissues aur organs. Inner cell mass mein stem cells hote hain jo har tissue bana sakte hain.

topics.title: Menarche and menopause
topics.explain: Puberty par pehli menstruation menarche hai; lagbhag 50 saal ki umar mein cycles ruk jaate hain (menopause). Pregnancy mein cycles ruk jaate hain aur stress ya kharab sehat se irregular ho sakte hain.

topics.title: Gestation
topics.explain: Human pregnancy lagbhag 9 mahine ki hoti hai. Second trimester ke end tak foetus par baarik baal, eyelids alag aur eyelashes ban jaati hain. Paanchve mahine mein aam taur par foetus ki pehli movements aur sir par baal dikhte hain.

ratta: Seminiferous tubules → rete testis → vasa efferentia → epididymis → vas deferens.
1 primary spermatocyte → 4 sperm;  1 primary oocyte → 1 ovum.
Fertilisation in ampulla;  implantation as blastocyst.
hCG, hPL, relaxin — only in pregnancy.
Pregnancy: heart after 1 month;  limbs/digits by end of month 2;  major organs by 12 weeks;  movements + head hair in month 5;  body hair, eyelids, eyelashes by 24 weeks.
